snippet.title: Cosmic Séance gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
COSMIC SEANCE is a séance based investigation game. You are the Royal Medium of a dying realm. Summon cosmic entities, trade sanity for truth, decipher their visions... or the abyss will consume you.

Demo is on the way, wishlist to get it right away!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5055670/Cosmic_Seance
